Source: Analyzing only those subjects who responded throughout the entire period, it is determined that opioid use disorder only minimally impairs individuals in their daily functioning.
Individuals are surveyed using a validated method and followed up in 6-month intervals for 5 years.
At the end of the study period, 40% of individuals have replied to the survey throughout the entire period.
A study is performed that looks at individuals who suffer from opioid use disorder and the effect the disorder has on their daily life and functionality.
